summary: Verified the seed_super_admin() SystemExit fix and full login/startup regression on PREVIEW. (1) Code review of /app/backend/utils/seed.py confirms NO 'SystemExit' or 'sys.exit' anywhere in the file; the fresh-DB + weak-password branch now logs logger.critical(...) and returns. (2) Direct simulation test (pytest) calls seed_super_admin() with SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL=TEST_nonexistent_sa_iter77@example.com + weak default password against the real DB: no SystemExit raised and NO user row created (correct refuse-but-don't-crash behaviour). (3) sudo supervisorctl restart backend -> backend RUNNING, logs show pool ready -> 'Schema verified' -> all standards seeds idempotent-skipped -> 'Updated superadmin@1two.one to super_admin role' -> 'Seeding complete' -> standards cache warmed (239) -> storage init -> 'Application startup complete'. No traceback/exit. GET /api/health = 200 {status: ok} in 0.33s before and after restart. (4) API login flows: manager@supervision.com -> requires_mfa + mfa_session -> verify-mfa -> access cookie + /auth/me 200 role=manager; superadmin@1two.one same flow -> role=super_admin; user@supervision.com (no MFA) -> direct cookie login; wrong password -> 401. (5) Live browser e2e on preview: staff login reached /dashboard in 2.7s with data rendered; manager login showed the 2FA 'Check your email' screen in ~4s, wrong code correctly showed 'Invalid code', correct code signed in to /dashboard in 2.1s. No login latency anywhere near the 20s threshold. (6) Regression: /app/backend/tests/test_idor_sec001.py 17/17 PASSED. New suite test_login_startup_iter77.py 9/9 PASSED. Note: hit a pre-existing IP rate limit (429, 20 attempts/15min) mid-run; cleared via tests/clear_rate_limit.py as advised, then all green.

minor.issue: FastAPI trailing-slash redirect returns 307 with Location: http://evidence-link-4.preview.emergentagent.com/api/dashboard/ (scheme downgraded to http because uvicorn/app is not proxy-header/root-scheme aware). In the browser this is blocked by the app's own CSP (connect-src 'self' https:) and surfaces as a console CSP error + 403. Harmless today because Dashboard.js uses the slashed URL, but any future call without a trailing slash will silently fail behind Cloudflare/HTTPS. Fix by running uvicorn with --proxy-headers / forwarded-allow-ips or setting redirect_slashes handling explicitly.

seed_all()/create_schema()/warm_standards() are still called with no try/except in @app.on_event('startup'). The specific SystemExit is gone, but any other unexpected exception in seeding (e.g. a transient DB error) will still abort startup and reproduce the same 'Cloudflare cannot parse response' crash-loop symptom. Recommend wrapping seeding in try/except with logger.exception so the API still boots.

ui_bugs.issue: Prefetch calls cachedGet(`${API}/dashboard`) without a trailing slash, triggering the http:// 307 redirect that CSP blocks (console error + 403 on every login). Add the trailing slash.
Subtitle reads 'We sent a 6-digit code to' with no email/masked address after 'to' — truncated/missing interpolation.

action_items: Optional hardening: wrap seed_all() in try/except inside the startup event so no seeding failure can ever take the API offline again.
Fix AuthContext.js:111 `${API}/dashboard` -> `${API}/dashboard/` (removes the CSP-blocked http redirect on every login).
Consider enabling uvicorn --proxy-headers so 307 slash redirects keep the https scheme behind Cloudflare.
Cosmetic: MFA screen shows 'We sent a 6-digit code to' with no address.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_super_admin() fix verified sound: is_weak computed once, fresh-DB+weak -> logger.critical + return (no row created, no exit); fresh-DB+strong -> INSERT; existing row -> role fix-up only, env password never re-applied. Idempotent and non-fatal on every path.
Remaining single point of failure is the unguarded startup sequence itself, not this function.

rca_of_the_issue: Original defect: seed_super_admin() raised SystemExit on any environment where the super_admin row was absent while SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD was the weak default, and it runs unguarded in the FastAPI startup event — killing the process on every boot, so Cloudflare saw an empty/malformed origin response and no user could log in. Fix (logger.critical + return) verified by source inspection and by directly invoking seed_super_admin() under the exact failing condition: it now logs and skips, creating no row and raising nothing. Backend restart confirmed a clean startup ('Seeding complete', 'Application startup complete') and all login paths work end-to-end.
